title: Here’s How Nancy Pelosi Beat the Stock Market and Warren Buffett

Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE:BRK-A)(NYSE:BRK-B), long the gold standard for patient capital, has matched that pace with about 13% annually over the same stretch. Impressive numbers for most investors. Yet both look like amateur hour next to the woman still serving out her final term in Congress: Nancy Pelosi.
